question: What is the difference between a mutable and an immutable object?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: What is the difference between a mutable and an immutable object?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: A mutable object's contents can change after it is created, in place.
beats.source_quote: A mutable object can be changed after it is created.

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: An immutable object's contents can never change — any edit makes a new object instead.
beats.source_quote: An immutable object cannot be changed once created; any edit produces a new object.

strategy.concept: objects fall into two categories by whether they can change
strategy.must_see: the two category names, side by side

strategy.concept: a mutable object changes in place; an immutable one never does
strategy.must_see: the same object shown once changing in place and once staying fixed while a new object appears beside it
strategy.changes_from_previous: the mutable panel's object updates; the immutable panel gains a second, separate object
